title: Sorry Eh Señor
style: Sneaky phonk with slinky half-time drums, rubbery sub pulses, beatboxed fills, and chanted backing singers layered like percussion; verse rides dry close-mic leads over marimba ticks and handclaps, pre-chorus filters up with harmonized oohs, chorus lands on gang-vocal callouts and panther-growl ad-libs. Ear candy: tongue clicks, reverse whistles, percussive breath hits. Bright, punchy, cheeky mix., comedy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I came in slow with a grin
Sorry, eh, let me in
Boots on the mat, no fuss
Mírame, I’m one of us

My toque’s tilted, nice and neat
Snow on my cuffs, don’t skip the beat
I say “my bad” in the queue
Luego digo “perdón” to you

[Pre-Chorus]
I’m harmless, I swear
Just a little bit there
Sneaking past with a smile
Ay, qué pena, wait a while

[Chorus]
Sorry, eh, señor
Sorry, eh, señor
I’m a panther with manners
Soft paws on the floor

Sorry, eh, señor
Sorry, eh, señor
Digo “sorry” in stereo
Then I’m out that door

(hey, sorry) (eh, sorry)
(ay, perdón) (canada)

[Verse 2]
At the rink I glide by clean
Cold air biting, still pristine
Got a wink and a chip
From the corner of my lip

“Pardon me” with a little twist
“¿Cómo estás?” on the list
I move smooth through the crowd
Polite and low, but loud

[Pre-Chorus]
I’m harmless, I swear
Just a little bit there
Sneaking past with a smile
Ay, qué pena, wait a while

[Chorus]
Sorry, eh, señor
Sorry, eh, señor
I’m a panther with manners
Soft paws on the floor

Sorry, eh, señor
Sorry, eh, señor
Digo “sorry” in stereo
Then I’m out that door

(hey, sorry) (eh, sorry)
(ay, perdón) (canada)

[Bridge]
Beatbox in the back lane
Brrt-kah, brrt-kah, okay
All my voices in a row
Ooh-la-la, let it go

One more “sorry” for the road
One more grin, one more glow
Panther slick in the snow
Mira cómo me voy

[Final Chorus]
Sorry, eh, señor
Sorry, eh, señor
I’m a panther with manners
Soft paws on the floor

Sorry, eh, señor
Sorry, eh, señor
Digo “sorry” in stereo
Then I’m out that door

(hey, sorry) (eh, sorry)
(ay, perdón) (canada)
